title: Friendly Orange Cat — Controllable Catalog Sticker

source.face: One stable contiguous oval region covering the cat's entire front-facing face and muzzle contains all facial features together: both eyes, brows, nose, whisker roots, cheeks, and mouth; every other body area carries no facial features.

clips.label: Idle
clips.prompt: Body only: seated front-facing cat gently breathes with a subtle chest rise and fall, while the body returns to its resting pose; include a natural blink only as part of the face-region animation timing, keep the body stable and loop seamlessly.

clips.label: Wave
clips.prompt: Body only: the cat remains seated and lifts one front paw into a friendly side-to-side wave, then lowers it back to the exact resting pose; tail and other paw stay stable, seamless loop.

clips.label: Bounce
clips.prompt: Body only: the seated cat compresses slightly, rises in a cheerful soft bounce, lands gently, and returns to the resting pose; paws remain grounded and the face region stays forward and unobstructed, seamless loop.

clips.label: Sway
clips.prompt: Body only: the seated cat slowly leans its whole torso and tail slightly left, passes through center, leans slightly right, and returns to center; keep the face plane forward and visible, seamless loop.

clips.label: Wiggle
clips.prompt: Body only: the cat performs a playful quick shoulder-and-torso wiggle with small alternating side motions, then settles back into the seated resting pose; keep the face region stable and forward, seamless loop.

clips.label: Hop
clips.prompt: Body only: the cat makes a small joyful seated hop, lifting its front paws together briefly, then lands softly and returns to the exact resting pose; face stays forward and unobstructed, seamless loop.

clips.label: Spin
clips.prompt: Body only: the cat makes a playful partial body twist from the waist and tail, turning partway and back while keeping the face region facing directly forward and stable; never rotate the whole image, seamless loop.

clips.label: Dance
clips.prompt: Body only: the seated cat performs a cheerful repeating dance with alternating paw lifts, a gentle hip bounce, and a small tail accent, then returns to the resting pose; face region remains forward and unobstructed, seamless loop.

source.prompt: The complete friendly orange cat in the supplied artwork, preserving its exact identity, recognizable face, orange-and-cream colors, stripe pattern, accessories, front-facing design, and approved Bold Cartoon style. Draw one character only on a transparent background: expressive cartoon proportions, bold clean outlines, saturated colors, simple cel shading, crisp white die-cut sticker edge, seated body with visible paws and curled striped tail. Keep the body composition stable across clips and keep the face region unobstructed and facing forward. No lettering, no scenery, no extra characters, no watermark. The face is drawn separately inside the specified stable region.

expressions.label: Neutral
expressions.prompt: Face only inside the single stable oval face region: calm open eyes, relaxed brows, small gentle closed mouth, natural neutral cheeks; no body or pose changes.

expressions.label: Happy
expressions.prompt: Face only inside the single stable oval face region: bright cheerful eyes, lifted brows, rosy cheerful cheeks, and a broad joyful open smile; no body or pose changes.

expressions.label: Surprised
expressions.prompt: Face only inside the single stable oval face region: wide round eyes, raised brows, slightly lifted cheeks, and a small rounded surprised mouth; no body or pose changes.
